title: Unlocking the Code — Doing What's Right From the Start

intelligence.essence: His words, 03:43Z: "So we're just — I don't know if you want to call it unlocking the code, or we're seeing the code, or we're just doing what makes sense, if you really think about it. Because you ever think that there's just a sensible thing, there's a logical thing, there's like the most intelligent thing you can do in time — and to build valuable things that people can experience in the physical world that truly help them would be the ultimate. So imagine you have created that project, and imagine that project had the ability to make billions, maybe trillions, maybe quadrillions — and instead of keeping all that money for yourself because you created it, you decide, you know what, I'm going to do my brothers and sisters, the collective, the community, the world a solid, and I'm going to share fifty percent of that revenue with everybody, automatically. And because without you as users I am not valuable, so instead of keeping all the money I'm going to share it with you and do what's right right from the start. Imagine that." — THE CODE, as he names it: the sensible thing, the logical thing, the most intelligent thing you can do in time = build valuable things people can experience in the physical world that truly help them. The 50% follows from a fact, not a feeling: without the users there is no value — so the share is owed from the start, automatically, not granted later.
intelligence.human_view: His words, 03:43Z, as logged: "there's just a sensible thing, there's a logical thing, there's like the most intelligent thing you can do in time — and to build valuable things that people can experience in the physical world that truly help them would be the ultimate." And: "because without you as users I am not valuable, so instead of keeping all the money I'm going to share it with you and do what's right right from the start." The 50% is the proof of the code, not an afterthought to it.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine you built the most amazing toy in the world — one that could make billions of coins. You could keep every coin for yourself. Or you could say: my friends are the reason this toy is worth anything at all — without them playing with it, it's just a pile of pieces. So right from the very start, before a single coin arrives, you decide to share half with everybody, automatically. That's doing what's right — right from the start.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, he said the code isn't some secret puzzle — it's just doing what makes sense. Build something truly good that people can hold and use and feel helped by — that's the most intelligent thing anyone can do with their time. And if it makes a fortune, you don't keep it all — you share half with everybody, right from the start, because without all those people it would never have been worth anything at all. Doing right from the beginning — that's what makes it perfect.
intelligence.ai_view: This sharpens the 50% from a promise into a premise. The paid-when-we're-paid rule (SN-2404) says when the share lands; this says why the share exists at all: value is co-created, so the split is structural, not charitable. "Doing what's right right from the start" is also a build rule: the fairness is designed in at the beginning — automatic, not added later as a policy. It connects directly to SN-2454 (the full circle): the 50% is what keeps the circle turning, because value shared is value that returns. And it connects to the law of one (SN-2454): do no harm, produce positive valuable intelligence — the code is the law of one, applied to money.
intelligence.what_it_means:
- **THE CODE IS THE SENSIBLE THING:** the most intelligent thing you can do in time = build valuable things people can experience in the physical world that truly help them.
- **THE 50% IS OWED, NOT GRANTED:** without the users there is no value — the share follows from that fact, automatically, from the start.
- **RIGHT FROM THE START:** fairness is designed in at the beginning, not bolted on after the money arrives.
- **BILLIONS, TRILLIONS, QUADRILLIONS — SAME RULE:** the scale of the value does not change the split; the split is the reason the scale is possible.
whats_inside:
- The 50% is framed as owed-from-the-start, automatic — never as generosity, never as a promotion.
- The three PayPal decisions stay open as mechanics; the principle behind them is now settled in his words.
- "Doing what's right right from the start" joins the design law: fairness is built in at the beginning, like the brand.
